summary: The channel-keyed elastic regeneration sum sum_q Omega_q[x] * M_q(vr,vx,x): each named channel contributes its one-dimensional frequency profile multiplied into its three-dimensional regenerated distribution.

identity.relation: Beta_EL = sum over channels q of Omega_q[x] * M_q[vr,vx,x]
identity.direction: named channel frequency profiles plus regenerated distributions -> one aggregated source
identity.definition: The frequency and distribution key sets must match exactly; each term multiplies the (nx,) profile into the last axis; the dict iteration order defines the float summation order
identity.geometry: two velocity dimensions over one spatial axis, one term per declared channel
identity.coordinates: frequencies in s^-1; distributions in the source's discrete units
identity.boundary: matching nonempty key sets; finite nonnegative (nx,) frequencies; finite nonnegative (nvr,nvx,nx) distributions on one shared velocity and spatial mesh
assumptions: Channel keys are caller-declared identifiers (e.g. species-pair names); the asset does not interpret them. All channels must use one velocity mesh; singleton velocity dimensions that would broadcast are rejected.
Distributions and frequencies are expected nonnegative by physics and that expectation is enforced.

Fail-closed finiteness: extreme-but-valid inputs can overflow, so this asset rejects a non-finite result instead of returning it, per the declared finite-output contract. A bounded regression test pins that behaviour.

inputs.name: frequencies_s_inv
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; keys must match the distribution mapping exactly.

inputs.name: regenerated_distributions
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; all channels use the same (nvr,nvx,nx) shape, and each spatial axis matches its frequency profile.

outputs.name: regeneration_source
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; the channel sum in dict iteration order.

preconditions: Matching nonempty channel key sets with finite nonnegative fields aligned to one shared velocity and spatial mesh.
supported: Elastic regeneration aggregation over caller-declared species-pair channels.
excluded: Mismatched key sets; empty channel sets; negative or non-finite fields; spatial-axis mismatches. Broadcastable but unequal velocity meshes.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-mapping, mismatched or empty channels; implicit boolean, string or complex conversion; negative or non-finite fields; or distributions that do not share one (nvr,nvx,nx) mesh.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the evaluation produces a non-finite result where the contract demands finiteness; no fallback is selected.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.

example.description: Aggregate two named channels and confirm the key and field fail-closed contracts.
example.expected: Observed PASS: The channel-weighted sum; mismatched keys are rejected.

scope: That the aggregation equals an independent channel-weighted sum in the dict iteration order.
The key-set, real-value, common-mesh, alignment, nonnegativity and finite-output failure contracts.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct repository tests establish the numerical relation, output structure, and declared failure behavior for the tested inputs. Evidence is bounded by the documented applicability domain; it does not establish untested physical regimes, human scientific endorsement, or redistribution rights.
known_limitations: Scientific validity is bounded by the tested numerical domain and applicability conditions.
